Meta.title: Where is Krecik? | Classroom focus game
Meta.description: A hidden-mole listening game: students track Krecik's moves on a grid in their heads, then the teacher reveals where he ended up.

page.title: Where is Krecik?
page.setupReady: Krecik starts at {coordinate}. Ready when you are!
page.setupEmpty: Pick a starting hole for Krecik, then start the round.
page.playingDemo: Demo: watch Krecik move and see how the rocks and wormholes work.
page.playingHidden: Krecik is hiding. Listen carefully and follow every move in your head!

toast.invalidDescription: That move would take him off the board.

setup.heading: Set up the board
setup.intro: Rocks and wormholes are optional — start whenever you are ready.
setup.placeFirst: Place Krecik on the board first.

moleStart.label: Krecik's start
moleStart.hint: Krecik starts in the highlighted hole. Click another hole to move him — everyone can see where he starts.

blocked.label: Blocked cell
blocked.hint: Click holes to put a rock in them. Krecik leaps over rocks. Click again to remove.

wormholeEntrance.label: Add wormhole
wormholeEntrance.hint: Click the hole where the wormhole starts. Click an existing wormhole to remove it.

wormholeDestination.label: Wormhole exit
wormholeDestination.hint: Now click where the wormhole comes out — any other hole on the board.

showToggle.label: Show Krecik on every move
showToggle.demo: Demo mode — everyone can watch him move.
showToggle.hidden: Krecik stays hidden until you reveal him.

pad.heading: Move Krecik
pad.demoHint: Demo mode — everyone can see Krecik. Say each move as you press it.
pad.hiddenHint: Eyes closed, everyone. Say each move out loud as you press it.
pad.keys: Arrow keys or numpad 1–9 to move · R to reveal

reveal.help: Replay runs the same round again from {start}. New round keeps the board; new game clears everything.

floating.dragHint: Drag to move · arrow keys nudge
